selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: The persistent drop-in was installed and applied. Before and after restart, all/default/enp1s0/lo reported accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0.

Healthy baseline boot ID fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34 was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, and command execution returned with boot ID 13bbe71b-db4c-41fe-a951-160a945e2bf6. Post-restart state was running with zero failed units, restored networking, and persisted hardening.

restorecon "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
sysctl --system
printf '%s\n' 'installed_dropin:'
